user.title: New template climate
user.description: Build a climate entity from templates (state) and actions (commands). Anything left empty works in optimistic mode. A feature (fan, preset, swing, humidity, target temperature) appears only if its template or its action is set.

data_description.device_id: Optional existing device to show this entity under.

state_templates.name: State templates
state_templates.description: Templates that read the current state. Results 'unknown' and 'unavailable' are ignored.

data_description.hvac_mode_template: Must return one of the selected HVAC modes.
data_description.hvac_action_template: One of: off, heating, cooling, drying, idle, fan, preheating, defrosting.
data_description.min_temp_template: Overrides the static value in Modes and limits.
data_description.max_temp_template: Overrides the static value in Modes and limits.

actions.name: Actions
actions.description: Run when the climate receives the matching command. The variable `this` and the advanced variables are always available.

modes_limits.name: Modes and limits
modes_limits.description: Selectable modes and temperature limits. Fan, preset and swing lists accept custom values.

advanced.name: Advanced
advanced.description: Availability, icon, picture, extra attributes and variables.

data_description.availability: The entity is available only when this template returns true.
data_description.variables: Variables available in templates and actions: name → value or template.

error.no_hvac_modes: Select at least one HVAC mode.
error.empty_mode_list: {field} cannot be empty when its template or action is set.
error.min_max_temp: Minimum temperature must be lower than maximum ({error}).
error.invalid_attributes: Attributes must be a mapping name → template.
